page_title: FIO 2-2 MON | Fiorentina v Monza 01/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' The yellow card goes to Roberto Gagliardini (Monza).
90+6' Fiorentina take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

90+6' 2 - 2 A perfectly taken corner kick. Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot into the top left corner, increasing the score of today's match – 2:2.
90+5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fiorentina.
90+5' Dodo (Fiorentina) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.

90' Superb goalkeeping! Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is given too much space inside the goalmouth and heads the ball towards the middle of the target, but the keeper shows his fast reflexes to keep the ball out.
85' The corner is swung in but Fiorentina can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
84' Fiorentina quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
83' Dodo (Fiorentina) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy. Fiorentina earn a corner.
81' Andrea Petagna (Monza) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
80' The referee allows time for a substitution. Pietro Comuzzo will be replaced by Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina).
80' We are about to witness a subsitution. Luca Caldirola (Monza) for Andrea Carboni.
79' Alessandro Nesta has decided to substitute Pedro Pereira and he is replaced by Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza).

77' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Stefano Turati tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
76' Armando Izzo (Monza) gets booked for the first time in this match.
69' We are about to witness a substitution. Samuele Vignato (Monza) is replacing Daniel Maldini.
69' Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
68' The substitution is prepared. Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Danilo Cataldi.
68' Raffaele Palladino decides to make a substitution. Andrea Colpani will be replaced by Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina).
63' Substitution. Andrea Petagna (Monza) on for Milan Djuric.
63' Substitution. Gianluca Caprari leaves the pitch and is replaced by Roberto Gagliardini (Monza).
58' Raffaele Palladino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) replacing Lucas Beltran.
58' It's time for a substitution. Edoardo Bove (Fiorentina) comes on in place of Rolando Mandragora.
57' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
54' The referee blows his whistle as Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) was too aggressive in his challenge. It's a free kick to Monza, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
48' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post!
47' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle as Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' Andrea Colombo has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' 1 - 2 Goal! Moise Kean (Fiorentina) puts the ball past the goalkeeper!
45' Goal! The resulting corner is whipped into the box and Moise Kean (Fiorentina) buries the ball into the back of the net from a Luca Ranieri knock down. 1:2.
45' The ball is out of play. Fiorentina win a corner kick.

41' OFF THE POST! Daniel Maldini (Monza) found himself some space to take a shot from just outside the box. His effort was headed to the bottom left corner, but Pietro Terracciano came up with a save and tipped the ball onto the post.

40' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Stefano Turati dived superbly to block a header by Moise Kean (Fiorentina) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the left post, but Stefano Turati pulled off a remarkable save!
38' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
32' 0 - 2 Daniel Maldini (Monza) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.
31' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Stefano Turati intercepts the ball.
30' One of the Fiorentina players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
23' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is punished with the yellow card.
20' The whistle blows and Matteo Pessina (Monza) is booked for an infringement.
18' 0 - 1 Milan Djuric (Monza) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom left corner. Magnificent finish!
17' Dodo (Fiorentina) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
13' Fiorentina are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
8' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
5' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Fiorentina have a free kick.
5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Fiorentina comes to nothing.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Fiorentina will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Andrea Colombo.
